subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira is a tiefling abyssal spawn researching infernal domains, currently under suspicion for a 'horrible tragedy' she claims she did not commit, and believes she has been framed.
source_quote: I'm willing to collaborate with anything, and I'm delighted — delighted — that you are leading the investigation.

subject: Daral Yashenti
fact: Daral Yashenti is a drunken poet who sells his worthless poetry to fund a new library; Sylvira dismissed him as too disorganized and incapable of the planning required to frame her.
source_quote: He's too much of a drunk to pull off something like that. That requires a level of planning and thought and care he's never demonstrated in any of his research.

subject: Kazryn Nyantani
fact: Kazryn Nyantani is a former romantic partner of Janussi, replaced by Sylvira; Sylvira implicated her in the framing out of long-standing resentment, breaking down emotionally while doing so.
source_quote: That bitter old hag, who always resented Janussi for ditching her in favor of me.

subject: Janussi
fact: Janussi is Sylvira’s current romantic partner, previously involved with Kazryn Nyantani; their relationship likely contributed to Sylvira being perceived as a target.

subject: Menzoberranzan
fact: Menzoberranzan is a drow city known for using psychological manipulation and deceit; Sylvira initially suspected its methods were being used against her but later dismissed the idea as a poor tactic.
source_quote: If that was a trick the drow use in Menzoberranzan — to twist the knife in their unsuspecting victims — it was a poor one.

subject: Overbright
fact: The Overbright is a surface region where tieflings are assumed to be abyssal spawns; Sylvira is from there and faces prejudice due to her appearance and research focus.
source_quote: In the Overbright, people look at a tiefling and assume she's an abyssal spawn.

subject: Underdark
fact: The Underdark is the subterranean realm from which Sylvira’s interrogator recently returned; it is associated with suspicion and hostility toward surface dwellers.
source_quote: I'd recently come up from the Underdark.

subject: framing incident
fact: Someone has used Sylvira’s likeness to commit acts she could not have performed, creating the appearance that she is responsible for a 'horrible tragedy'.
source_quote: Your likeness has been seen moving around, doing things you couldn't possibly have done?

subject: unpublished research
fact: Sylvira may possess unpublished research that could be the real motive behind the framing, though she has not yet disclosed it.
source_quote: Something she'd found and hadn't published yet.

subject: lilac robes
fact: Sylvira wears lilac robes that fail to protect her from an internal cold, symbolizing her vulnerability despite her outward composure.
source_quote: the lilac robes she'd wrapped herself in accomplishing nothing against a cold she clearly felt in her bones.

subject: session date
fact: This interview occurred during a single, continuous session with Sylvira, initiated by the interrogator’s questions and ending with her speculative analysis of suspects.
source_quote: I said it without ceremony. I had questions that needed her full cognitive engagement.

subject: abyssal spawn
fact: Abyssal spawn is a biological classification Sylvira belongs to; it is the source of prejudice against her in the Overbright, though she is not a hostile entity.
source_quote: She happened, technically, to be an abyssal spawn, so they weren't even wrong.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is the interrogator conducting the interview with Sylvira; he is from the Overbright, recently returned from the Underdark, and seeks testimony rather than confession.
source_quote: I am merely one of many doing the investigation.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a colleague of Daz who is investigating a dead man’s love nest three floors up; Daz contrasts his blunt style with Grygum’s absence.
source_quote: What I was trying to understand... was the blunter version of the same question: the one Grygum would have asked outright...

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is an absent colleague of Daz, currently preparing to make Alkrist uncomfortable; he does not offer emotional support to Sylvira.
source_quote: Thorin wasn't in the room to offer the easy sympathy.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist is a person Thorin is preparing to confront; their relationship is unknown, but their interaction is anticipated to be hostile.
source_quote: He was off somewhere getting ready to make Alkrist very uncomfortable.

subject: frumpy old boar
fact: Sylvira’s cryptic reference to 'a frumpy old boar' during her emotional breakdown may hint at an unspoken rival or symbolic figure in her academic circle.
source_quote: Something about a frumpy old boar.

subject: academic rivalry
fact: Sylvira’s research in infernal domains and her relationship with Janussi have created tensions within her academic circle, possibly motivating the framing.
source_quote: Her area of research was the infernal domains, which compounded the prejudice. The relationship with Janussi had probably offended someone else on top of that.

subject: Sylvira's quarters
fact: Sylvira’s quarters are artificially heated by a faux fireplace, yet she remains cold and shivering, reflecting her psychological and emotional state.
source_quote: Her quarters were suffocating. A faux fireplace blazed along one wall... yet Sylvira kept shuddering anyway.
